description: Exploit. Tests a proposed new child of H2.3: accuracy is set mainly in the final 32 px phase, so the 28 px middle phase can be dropped cheaply. On the E015 recipe (Muon, Lookahead/EMA, CUDA graphs, 9 epochs, last group 512), change only the resolution schedule from 24/28/32 px at 40/30/30% of steps to 24/32 px at 70/30% of steps. The 32 px tail keeps exactly its current step count and position, so the LR and EMA schedules stay the same. Build no longer needs the 28 px graph; keep the 24 and 32 px warm-up and capture, and keep error_on_recompile on after build.
